about: What each standard kit contains, taken from docs/launch/03-hardware-and-wiring.md, section 2 (the rows, the quantities and the planning estimates in EUR, excluding VAT and labour). The site packs, the hardware reference and the shopping lists in the guides are all written from this one file, so they cannot disagree with each other. Change a figure here and rebuild. The estimates are planning figures, not quotes.

box.spec: Fanless x86 mini PC (see the box specification), 8 GB, 128 GB or more SSD or eMMC, 12 to 24 V DC input
box.does: Reads the meters and sensors and reports to Greecon. If the internet is down it keeps about three days of readings (for a site of up to about thirteen devices) and sends them in order when the internet returns.

converter.spec: RS-485 to Ethernet, DIN rail, 9 to 36 V DC, Modbus TCP to RTU gateway mode
converter.does: Puts the meters' cable (RS-485) on the network, so that the box can reach every meter and module on it. It must be in Modbus TCP to RTU gateway mode.

meter3.spec: Eastron SDM630 Modbus. The MCT version comes with three clamp-on current sensors for up to 100 A a phase; for more than 100 A, the ordinary SDM630 with 5 A current transformers
meter3.does: Measures electrical power on three phases. One at the grid connection gives both Grid import and Grid export; one on the inverter's AC output gives Solar production. Fitted by the electrician.

analog.spec: Modbus RTU, at least 4 channels, 4 to 20 mA, 7 to 36 V DC
analog.does: Reads the 4 to 20 mA signals of the level, pressure and flow transmitters, and the pump's run contact, and answers the box on the same RS-485 cable as the meters.

pumpin.spec: A Modbus RTU digital input (dry contact) module, or one spare channel of a combined module
pumpin.does: Reports whether the pump is running, from a spare contact of its starter. It only reports; it never switches anything.

level.spec: Submersible, vented cable, 4 to 20 mA, range at least the tank's height, wetted parts approved for drinking water (or a non-contact ultrasonic sensor above the tank)
level.does: Measures how full the tank is. It hangs at the bottom of the tank.

pressure.spec: 4 to 20 mA, range to suit the pipe (0 to 10 bar is usual), stainless wetted parts
pressure.does: Measures the pressure in the pipe, through an isolating valve so that it can be removed without draining.

flow.spec: 4 to 20 mA output. Needed for "the pump is running but no water is flowing"
flow.does: Measures the flow in the pipe. Without it (or without the pump's running contact) the alert for a pump that runs with no water moving cannot be raised.

psu.does: Powers the input module, the loop transmitters and the converter from one place.

ups.spec: A 12 V DC UPS for the box and converter, or a 600 VA line-interactive UPS
ups.does: Keeps the box and the converter up through short power cuts and long enough to say that the grid is down.

enclosure.spec: IP54 (IP65 outdoors), DIN rail, terminals, fuses or small breakers for the meters' voltage taps, glands
enclosure.does: Holds the converter, the input module, the supply, the fuses, the terminal blocks and, if there is room, the box.

cable.spec: Shielded twisted pair for the RS-485 line, network patch cords, ferrules, labels
cable.does: The RS-485 data cable (shielded twisted pair), network patch cords, ferrules and labels.

cell.does: Gives the box and the converter an internet connection where the site has no usable one: a 4G router with a data SIM.

sdm230.spec: Eastron SDM230, on the pump's feed, to measure its electricity
sdm230.does: Measures the electricity of one pump or a small load (single-phase), on its own feed.

soil.spec: RS-485 Modbus, with a published register table, one for each zone
soil.does: Measures soil moisture at the probe's depth. Its depth and place are written down, because soil readings mean little without them.

climate.spec: RS-485 Modbus, with a published register table
climate.does: Measures air temperature and humidity at the field.
